item.title: Version 0.4.1
item.description:
• Apple Watch: if a workout can't start, the Watch now says why (for example, when Health hasn't been allowed to save workouts) instead of doing nothing. A workout left half-started no longer blocks the next one.
  • Discard a paused workout from the Train page: swipe its card left, or long-press it.
  • Fix: the place menu ("At Home") showed twice on the iPhone's Train and Exercises pages.
  • Tidier Train page: the Empty workout button no longer wraps, and the guided workouts footer is shorter.

item.title: Version 0.4.0
item.description:
OnePulse 0.4.0 adds training: a gym logger, guided workouts, plans and an Apple Watch app.

  • **Train page:** log workouts set by set, save routines, and see your history and personal records. Each set shows what you did last time and what to try next.
  • **Exercise library:** 171 exercises with a picture of each move, as a woman or a man (pick one in Training Settings).
  • **Guided workouts:** Quick HIIT, Full Body, Core and Mobility, plus Chest, Back, Shoulders, Arms, Legs, Glutes, Upper and Lower Body in 10, 20 or 30 minutes. They're built from the equipment where you train, with spoken cues in a woman's or man's voice to match your picture.
  • **Plans and a daily suggestion:** multi-week training plans, and a workout picked for today from your readiness: lighter on tired days, harder on good ones.
  • **Apple Watch:** start your plan, a routine or a guided workout right from the Watch, without the iPhone. You get heart rate, calories, reps counted from your wrist, rest timers and timed sets. Workouts started on the iPhone open on the Watch too.
  • **Apple Health:** finished workouts are saved with calories estimated from your body and heart rate.
  • **Progress:** a muscle recovery map, training goals (workouts per week, lift targets), and training on Summary, Weekly Review and Year in Review. The workout also shows on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island.
  • Live step count on the iPhone.

item.title: Version 0.3.6
item.description:
• Fix: after updating, the iPhone didn't ask for access to ECGs and workout routes, and Cloud Sync stopped with "Authorization not determined". It now asks once when you open the app, and the rest of your data keeps syncing until you answer.
  • The iPad now checks for new data each time you open it.

item.title: Version 0.3.5
item.description:
• ECG recordings from Apple Watch: a new ECG card on the Heart page, each recording drawn on ECG paper with its result and a beat-to-beat chart.
  • Workout details: tap a workout for its route map coloured by pace, elevation, per-km splits and heart-rate zones.
  • Siri and Shortcuts: ask for readiness, sleep, streaks, any metric, your last workout or ECG, log a medication, or open a page.
  • Spotlight: search your metrics and OnePulse pages.
  • The heads-up card on Summary can be dismissed.
  • Fix: daily charts could miss the morning of the first day for some metrics.
  • The iPhone asks once more for Health access, to read ECGs and workout routes.

item.title: Version 0.3.4
item.description:
• Tapping a widget opens its page: Steps and Metric open that metric, Sleep, Medications, Readiness, Streaks and Goal open theirs.
  • Steps (and any metric with a daily goal): bars are green when you hit the day's goal (eased goals count), yellow when close and red when well short, with a goal line.
  • New streak card on those pages: days in a row, best, what's left today, the last 14 days, and your best day. Edit the goal right from the card.
  • Confetti the first time you open the page after reaching the day's goal.
  • Activity pages without a daily goal offer to set one.

item.title: Version 0.3.3
item.description:
• New widgets: Steps, Medications (tap to mark a dose taken), Sleep, Metric (choose any metric) and Goal (choose a goal), with Lock Screen sizes on iPhone.
  • Fixed: Mac sync could stop after an iCloud download failed, until the app was relaunched.

item.title: Version 0.3.2
item.description: • Fixed: on iPhone, the Goals page could be dragged sideways. No page scrolls sideways now.

item.title: Version 0.3.1
item.description:
Fixed

  • Metric pages (Steps, Weight and others): the Average, Lowest, Highest and Total row no longer sits on top of the chart, and the samples line under the name isn't cut off on iPhone.
  • Goal editor: the unit sits next to the target instead of under the label.
  • Charts in light mode: the "avg" label and the tap callout were black pills; they're readable again.
  • Habit calendar on iPhone: shows about six months at a readable size instead of a year of tiny dots.
  • Summary: milestone names no longer get cut off.

Changed

  • **What it's doing for you** now needs at least 20 days each of kept and missed days before showing a difference, so a few unusual days can't decide it. Findings are grouped under each streak, the card sits below your goals, and each streak's habit calendar shows its own findings.

item.title: Version 0.3.0
item.description:
New: streaks and motivation

  • **Streaks that forgive a day off.** Every ring and habit goal keeps a streak. Plan up to two rest days a week, and every 7 days kept earns a freeze (up to 2) that covers a missed day. Settings are behind the gear on the Goals page.
  • **Targets that adapt.** On "Take it easy" readiness days, 85% of a ring or activity goal keeps the streak (75% on Recover days). When a habit is kept almost every day for two weeks, its card offers a slightly higher target.
  • **Evening reminder (iPhone).** One nudge at 7 pm (you can change it) when a streak is close but not kept yet, e.g. "12 min of exercise keeps your 9-day streak".
  • **Monday check-in (iPhone).** Last week in two lines, your streaks, the month's challenge and one thing to work on. Tap it for the full weekly review.
  • **Records & Milestones.** Personal bests from your history, and badges for steps, distance, workouts and ring streaks, with progress towards the next one.
  • **Monthly challenge.** One ring goal for the month, set a little above last month.
  • **Year in Review.** Your year in numbers, with a story-sized image to share. Heart and fitness numbers stay off the image.
  • **What it's doing for you.** How your sleep, readiness, HRV and resting heart rate compare after the days you keep a streak.
  • **Habit calendar.** A year of any streak at a glance, with your hardest weekday. Tap a streak on the Goals page.
  • **Streaks widget.** For the Lock Screen and Home Screen, and the Mac.
  • **For agents:** a new MCP tool, `get_streaks`.

item.title: Version 0.2.2
item.description:
New

  • **Activity Rings page.** Tapping the rings card on Summary now opens all three rings: today (or any day you pick), days closed and streaks for Move, Exercise and Stand, a five-week calendar of rings, and a chart for each ring against your goal.

Fixed

  • Metric pages showed "–" instead of today's total (steps, energy, distance and other daily totals).
  • Workouts: the weekly chart no longer flickers when you hover over it.
  • Compare fits the iPhone screen; the correlation grid fits four metrics and scrolls sideways for more.
  • Labels no longer break across two lines: the Readiness legend, the Range picker, metric subtitles and Compare metric names.
  • Workout totals sit in one row (or two even rows), and page header buttons line up with the cards.
  • Smaller fixes: a readable average label on charts, "1 batch" on Sync, "Tap" instead of "Click" on iPhone and iPad.

item.title: Version 0.2.1
item.description:
New

  • **Compare any number of metrics** (2–8): a matrix shows how every pair moves together, the strongest links are listed, and all of them share one chart over time. Click a square for that pair's details.
  • Metrics logged only now and then (like weight) show as their readings, with a note when there are too few to compare.
  • An "Updating…" badge when a screen is recalculating.

Improved

  • Much faster: switching periods on Compare went from seconds to a fraction of one, and other screens that go day by day are quicker too.
  • Goal cards side by side now line up.

item.title: Version 0.2.0
item.description:
The first public release of OnePulse for Mac.

New

  • Every time chart is interactive: hover for the exact values, drag across to zoom into any period, then move earlier or later.
  • "All" range on Heart, Sleep and Training Load, for your complete history.
  • The iPad gets its own sidebar dashboard, like the Mac.
  • Updates through Sparkle: OnePulse checks in the background, or use OnePulse › Check for Updates….
  • Install with Homebrew: brew install --cask jhasubhash/tap/onepulse

Fixed

  • Training Load's range picker with the new All option.
  • Importing several lab PDFs at once keeps every report.
  • The resting heart rate line is readable in light mode.
